sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT *
FROM @{concat('usr_comsys','.',item().nombretabla)} 
WHERE coalesce(D_MODIFICADO,'1900-02-01 00:00:00.000')>'@{activity('LookupbBusTableslastloadTrans').output.firstRow.lastload}'
AND coalesce(D_MODIFICADO,'1900-02-01 00:00:00.000')<='@{activity('Lookuplastestload').output.firstRow.latestload}'

source.sqlReaderQuery:
select tablename,schemaname
from
(
select 
 REPLACE(REPLACE(QUOTENAME(t.name),'[',''),']','') as tablename
,REPLACE(REPLACE(QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id)),'[',''),']','') as schemaname
from sys.tables as t
where QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id)) not in ('[dbo]')
) x
where tablename in ('MEDIO','TIPO_MEDIO','COBERTURA','PRODUCTO','TIPO_PRODUCTO','EJECUTIVO','FORMA_FACTURA','CONDICION_PAGO','CLIENTE','CATEGORIA_DIGITAL','TIPO_COMPONENTE')
